svg.text: How users, agents, roles, departments, teams, SLA plans, and help topics relate once osTicket is configured.
Add the Supreme Admin role with every Tickets, Tasks, and Knowledgebase permission.
Add System Administrators; each agent needs a primary department and a role to save.
User settings require registration and login to create tickets; add Byleth and Dimitri.
SLA plans set grace periods: Sev-A 1 hour, Sev-B 4 hours, Sev-C 8 business hours.
Business Critical Outage sets System Administrators, Open, Emergency, and Sev-A.
The same help topic auto-assigns new tickets to the Level II Support team.
